prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: Furina four-frame victory animation sprite atlas for a fighting game. Reference image is canonical Furina idle full-body model, lock its entire adult slim physique, not merely face. Generate FOUR chronologically ordered full-body poses in two rows, two poses per row, generous transparent gutters and margin, without panel lines or labels. ALL FOUR CHARACTERS use one identical drawing scale: identical skull width/height, neck-to-pelvis length, upper-arm/forearm lengths, thigh/shin lengths, boot sizes, shoulder breadth. Preserve identity, long white hair, blue/gold/white outfit with shorts, thigh strap, both boots, crown details, thin navy ink outlines and anime painted style. Exactly two arms and two complete connected legs/boots per pose; five natural fingers per visible hand, hands contact hat plausibly; no duplicated limbs, no floating boots. Keep full crown, hair curls and boots inside image with transparent margin. NO background, floor, shadow, glow, effects, words, labels, other people or foreign cropped fragments. Do not use chibi proportions, short legs, enlarged heads or perspective scaling between poses. First and last upright stance must have the same overall physique as the source idle, NOT an independently redesigned small model.
policy: first/last display state reuse exact idle; raised hat and bow are new source candidates; not art acceptance
